additional_info.body:
Hello,
As I wrote when I opened the ticket, a client started to charger today 14 of January at 4:10:06 PM CU TIME but the charge stopped suddenly at 4:15:53 PM CU TIME and the connector was blocked into the client's car. Also, the service station attendant told us that frequently the charges interrupt on their own lately.
Can you please check the logs for the timestamp I provided and also do a general check on the charger?
I opened the ticket through the customer portal, but recently it often happens that I need to rewrite it via email because the details aren’t visible on your side.
Thank you,
Rosita Abate
